pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does maha mean in Mahabhoot? (1 mark)
   A. Great
   B. New
   C. Old
   D. Small

2. Which element is called Agni? (1 mark)
   A. Air
   B. Space
   C. Fire
   D. Water

3. Which faith do Tulsi and the Ganga belong to most closely? (1 mark)
   A. Sikhism
   B. Jainism
   C. Buddhism
   D. Hinduism

4. Which of these is one of the five great elements? (1 mark)
   A. Salt
   B. Akash
   C. Metal
   D. Wood

5. Who brought Siddhartha up after his mother died? (1 mark)
   A. A teacher
   B. His cousin Devadatta
   C. His aunt Mahaprajapati Gotami
   D. A king

6. A snake is often shown with statues of which Tirthankar? (1 mark)
   A. Buddha
   B. Narsimha
   C. Guru Ram Das
   D. Parshvanath

7. Who was Devadatta in the story? (1 mark)
   A. Siddhartha's cousin
   B. A Jain monk
   C. Siddhartha's father
   D. A Sikh Guru

8. Who was Hiranyakashipu? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A festival
   C. A proud and cruel king
   D. A good teacher

9. Narsimha is an Avtar of which god? (1 mark)
   A. Lord Buddha
   B. Lord Shiva
   C. Lord Vishnu
   D. Lord Ganesh

10. What is a kaand in the Ramayan? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A river
   C. A section or book of the Ramayan
   D. A festival

11. A child promises to return a friend's book on time. Which scripture lesson is being followed? (1 mark)
   A. Sitting on heels
   B. Keeping a promise, as in the Ramayan
   C. Not stealing, as in Rijubalika
   D. Making a fast

12. Which Jain scripture gives advice on a disciplined life? (1 mark)
   A. Dhammapada
   B. Sigalovada Sutta
   C. Uttaradhyayan Sutra
   D. Ramayan

13. What is a scripture? (1 mark)
   A. A holy book with teachings
   B. A type of food
   C. A kind of festival
   D. A musical instrument

14. What does the Gayatri Mantra ask for? (1 mark)
   A. A big house
   B. Wisdom
   C. Money
   D. Rain

15. What does Vandana mean? (1 mark)
   A. An act of respect and prayer
   B. A meal
   C. A tree
   D. A river

16. What does the book stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Food
   B. Fire
   C. Knowledge
   D. Rain

17. What greeting shows respect with folded hands? (1 mark)
   A. Shalom
   B. Hujambo
   C. Sat Sri Akal
   D. Namaste

18. When is the Gayatri Mantra a good prayer to say? (1 mark)
   A. Never
   B. Only at the market
   C. Before studying
   D. Only in the night

19. What is prasad? (1 mark)
   A. A garden
   B. A kind of shoe
   C. Blessed food shared after prayers
   D. A prayer book

20. What does the Gayatri Mantra compare wisdom to? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A mountain
   C. Light
   D. A drum

21. What is aarti? (1 mark)
   A. Painting
   B. Reading a map
   C. Waving a lamp in front of the murti while singing
   D. Eating

22. You find Ksh 100 on the school field. What shows integrity? (1 mark)
   A. Keep it quietly
   B. Spend it on sweets
   C. Give it to the teacher so it can be returned
   D. Give it away

23. Which statement about integrity is true? (1 mark)
   A. It is only for teachers
   B. It includes small daily choices
   C. It is only for adults
   D. It is only for big things

24. Who should be allowed to board first? (1 mark)
   A. The fastest
   B. The strongest
   C. The loudest
   D. Children, elders and people with disabilities

25. What does Sadachaar mean? (1 mark)
   A. Good conduct
   B. A holy river
   C. A festival
   D. Daily prayer

26. Which organisation set International Yoga Day? (1 mark)
   A. The United Nations
   B. A school
   C. A bank
   D. A local school

27. What does Kama mean? (1 mark)
   A. A festival
   B. Cruelty
   C. War
   D. Good and healthy wishes such as joy and friendship

28. Which is an act of Prani Daya? (1 mark)
   A. Giving water to a thirsty animal
   B. Wasting food
   C. Throwing stones at a dog
   D. Breaking plants

29. Which principle is about the Supreme Soul? (1 mark)
   A. Punarjanam
   B. Prarthana
   C. Prani Daya
   D. Paramatma

30. What does the Vedic saying say about the truth? (1 mark)
   A. It is one but is called by many names
   B. It is unknown
   C. It is only for kings
   D. It has many separate truths

31. How many Purusharthas are there? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Ten
   C. Four
   D. Two

32. In the Shibi story, what did the hawk want? (1 mark)
   A. Water
   B. A crown
   C. The dove as food
   D. A house

33. Who became the first Prime Minister of Kenya at that time? (1 mark)
   A. Daniel arap Moi
   B. Jomo Kenyatta
   C. Tom Mboya
   D. Mwai Kibaki

34. What is Madaraka Day? (1 mark)
   A. A Hindu festival
   B. A Jain festival
   C. A sports day
   D. A Kenyan national holiday on 1 June

35. Maha Shivratri is a festival of which faith? (1 mark)
   A. Sikhism
   B. Jainism
   C. Buddhism
   D. Hinduism

36. In which months does Paryushan usually occur? (1 mark)
   A. August or September
   B. June
   C. December
   D. February or March

37. Which day is linked with Jupiter? (1 mark)
   A. Friday
   B. Tuesday
   C. Thursday
   D. Saturday

38. What is the Indian name for Friday? (1 mark)
   A. Somvaar
   B. Shukravaar
   C. Budhvaar
   D. Guruvaar

39. Which is the first month listed in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Chaitra
   B. Kartika
   C. Magha
   D. Phalguna

40. Budh is the Indian name for which planet? (1 mark)
   A. Mercury
   B. Saturn
   C. Jupiter
   D. Mars

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Who was Sri Guru Ram Das Ji's teacher and predecessor? (2 marks)

42. Explain why the Indian traditional calendar is special and how a child can use it. (5 marks)

43. Explain the Jain teaching called Asteya. (2 marks)

44. Give two signs of integrity. (2 marks)

45. State two things people do on Maha Shivratri. (2 marks)

46. Why should a passenger wait for the vehicle to stop before getting off? (2 marks)

47. Compare the three festivals: Maha Shivratri, Paryushan Parva and Madaraka Day. (5 marks)

48. Describe Bharat's action after he returned to Ayodhya. (3 marks)

49. Explain the Sikh idea of Kirat Karni. (2 marks)

50. Explain four lessons we learn from the Ramayan. (4 marks)

51. What does Prani Daya mean? (2 marks)

52. Explain what we learn from the lives of any two Enlightened Beings. (4 marks)

53. Give three safety measures to observe during festivals. (3 marks)

54. Explain the importance of celebrating Madaraka Day. (3 marks)

55. Describe how the Bodhi tree is linked with the Buddha. (3 marks)

56. Describe how to do Sasankasana. (4 marks)

57. Which day is Shanivaar and which planet is it linked with? (2 marks)

58. Give two lessons of the Bal Kaand. (2 marks)

59. Give three benefits of yoga. (3 marks)

60. Write a short paragraph on why honesty is the best policy. (5 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Great
   Maha means great and bhoot means element.

2. C — Fire
   Agni means fire, heat and light.

3. D — Hinduism
   Both are honoured especially in Hindu tradition.

4. B — Akash
   The five elements are Prithvi, Jal, Agni, Vayu and Akash.

5. C — His aunt Mahaprajapati Gotami
   His mother's sister looked after him.

6. D — Parshvanath
   The snake is a sign of Parshvanath.

7. A — Siddhartha's cousin
   Devadatta was a cousin.

8. C — A proud and cruel king
   He was Prahlad's proud father.

9. C — Lord Vishnu
   Narsimha is one of Lord Vishnu's Avtars.

10. C — A section or book of the Ramayan
   The Ramayan is divided into kaands.

11. B — Keeping a promise, as in the Ramayan
   Ram kept promises.

12. C — Uttaradhyayan Sutra
   It teaches Ahimsa, truth and control of anger.

13. A — A holy book with teachings
   Scriptures hold the wisdom of great teachers.

14. B — Wisdom
   It asks that the divine light guide our minds.

15. A — An act of respect and prayer
   Vandana is respectful prayer.

16. C — Knowledge
   The book stands for knowledge.

17. D — Namaste
   Namaste is done with folded hands.

18. C — Before studying
   It is a prayer for wisdom.

19. C — Blessed food shared after prayers
   Prasad is blessed food.

20. C — Light
   Wisdom is like light that clears away darkness.

21. C — Waving a lamp in front of the murti while singing
   It is a prayer with a lamp.

22. C — Give it to the teacher so it can be returned
   A lost note belongs to its owner.

23. B — It includes small daily choices
   Small choices count.

24. D — Children, elders and people with disabilities
   We care for those who need help.

25. A — Good conduct
   Sadachaar is the way a good person behaves.

26. A — The United Nations
   The UN chose the day in 2014.

27. D — Good and healthy wishes such as joy and friendship
   Kama is good and healthy desire.

28. A — Giving water to a thirsty animal
   Kindness to living beings.

29. D — Paramatma
   Paramatma is God.

30. A — It is one but is called by many names
   The truth is one, the wise call it by many names.

31. C — Four
   There are four.

32. C — The dove as food
   The hawk demanded the dove.

33. B — Jomo Kenyatta
   Jomo Kenyatta was the first Prime Minister.

34. D — A Kenyan national holiday on 1 June
   It celebrates self-government.

35. D — Hinduism
   It is a Hindu festival.

36. A — August or September
   It falls in Bhadrapada.

37. C — Thursday
   Guruvaar.

38. B — Shukravaar
   Shukra is Venus.

39. A — Chaitra
   Chaitra comes first and Phalguna last.

40. A — Mercury
   Budh is Mercury.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Guru Amar Das Ji, the third Guru.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the name and 1 mark for third Guru.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: It links daily life to the sky and seasons, keeps tradition alive and fixes festival dates. A child can make a weekly plan, a decorated calendar, greeting cards or a song.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for why it is special and 3 marks for uses.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Not taking what is not given, or not stealing.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for a correct meaning.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Telling the truth, keeping promises, returning what is not yours, not cheating (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Fast, stay awake all night, bathe the Shiva Linga, offer bel leaves, chant Om Namah Shivaya (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Moving while the vehicle is moving can cause falls and accidents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for danger, 1 mark for safety.

47. (5 marks)
   Answer: Maha Shivratri is Hindu, a night of prayer for Shiva. Paryushan is Jain, of fasting and forgiveness. Madaraka Day is national, about self-government and patriotism. All bring people together.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for correct faith or type, 2 marks for themes, 1 mark for a similarity.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: He refused the throne, went to ask Ram to return, took Ram's sandals and placed them on the throne, and ruled as a humble servant.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: Earning a living by honest work.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for earning and 1 mark for honest work.

50. (4 marks)
   Answer: Keep promises, respect elders, be humble, do not be greedy for power, love your brothers and sisters, and be courageous (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: Kindness to all living beings.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for kindness and living beings.

52. (4 marks)
   Answer: Any two, for example: from Prahlad's story that faith and honesty can defeat pride, and from Siddhartha that we must be kind to hurt animals.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each being with a correct lesson.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: Adults light lamps, stay with adults in crowds, wash hands before eating, use bins, walk and do not run (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: It reminds us of Kenya's step to self-government on 1 June 1963, teaches patriotism and unity, and lets us respect the flag and the anthem.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Prince Siddhartha sat under a Bodhi tree at Bodh Gaya and became the Buddha, the Awakened One. Buddhists honour the tree because of this.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the tree, 1 mark for Siddhartha, 1 mark for enlightenment or Bodh Gaya.

56. (4 marks)
   Answer: Start in Vajra Asana, breathe in and raise the arms, breathe out and bend forward, rest the forehead on the mat with arms stretched forward, breathe calmly and come up slowly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for four correct steps.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: Saturday, linked with Saturn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: Respect for parents and teachers, love between brothers, courage to protect others, obedience to wise guidance (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: It keeps the body flexible and strong, helps us breathe well and stay calm, helps us focus and teaches discipline (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

60. (5 marks)
   Answer: An honest person is trusted, feels calm, makes friends, keeps a good name and helps the community. A liar loses trust. Examples such as returning lost money or not cheating support the paragraph.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the topic, 2 marks for reasons, 1 mark for an example, 1 mark for a clear conclusion.
